refusal.tooFast: You are sending requests too fast. Please wait about a minute and try again.
refusal.invalid: The data sent is not valid. Check your list of links and try again.
refusal.generic: Could not send the download list (error code {{status}}). Please try again in a few minutes.

safeJson.maintenance: 🔧 The server is under maintenance or restarting. Please try again in a few seconds.
safeJson.rateLimited: ⏳ You have sent too many requests. Please wait 1 minute and try again.

douyinHint.title: Want every video from this channel?
douyinHint.body: The server can only get the newest videos. Use the VidGrab extension to get them all: open the channel page on Douyin, press the scroll button on the VidGrab panel, wait for the done message, then press send to download.

errNetwork: Network error, the list was not sent. Check your internet connection and try again.
errSubmit: Could not send the download list. Please try again.
zipFailed: Could not create the ZIP file: {{message}}

kw.tooShort: The keyword must be at least 3 characters.
kw.rateLimited: You have searched too much. Try again later.
kw.label: Keyword
kw.movedToBulk: The URLs will be moved to the Bulk URL tab to download.

title: Bulk Download
subtitle: Process many videos or a whole channel at once
pasteHint: One link per line. You can paste many URLs or import a .txt / .csv file.

modeHint.channel: Turn this on when you paste a channel/profile link instead of a single video link.
modeHint.search: Search videos by keyword and pick the ones to download.
modeHint.container: Preview and pick content before queueing the download.
modeHint.bulk: Paste video links directly to download in bulk.

watermarkOnlyTikTok: Only applies to TikTok and Douyin.
watermarkHint: Download the version without logo/watermark (TikTok, Douyin).
listToChoose: View the video list to choose
channelModeDesc: Automatically extract and filter the videos in the channel

hint.twitter: Enter @username or a profile link. Downloads videos from the public Media tab. Limit 100 videos per run — Twitter rate-limits large scrapes very tightly.
hint.reddit: Enter a subreddit link (r/videos) or a user page. Supports hot/new/top sorting. Only posts with video are fetched. Up to 50 videos per run.
hint.pinterest: Enter a board link (pinterest.com/user/board-name). Only Video Pins are downloaded. Private boards will report an error.
hint.threads: Enter @username or a public profile link. Fetches up to 100 recent posts with media.

howManyHint: Choose how many videos to scan from the channel. If you are new, try 10–50 videos first.
douyinChannelNote: Douyin channel: the server can get about the 40 newest videos. To get the whole channel, use the VidGrab extension for Chrome or the VidGrab app for Windows.
xhsChannelNote: Xiaohongshu/Kuaishou channel: sign-in required; each scan is limited to 20 videos and no more than the downloads you have left today.
twitterLimit: Twitter rate limit: more than 50 videos may be slow or interrupted.
batchNote: 💡 Videos are processed in batches (10 videos per batch) for better performance
importFile: Import URLs from a .txt or .csv file

rename.title: Rename & Download ZIP
rename.tokenHint: Click a token to insert it into the pattern:
rename.placeholderNote: ? = value filled in when the ZIP is created

discover.slowNote: YouTube can take 30–90 seconds to load the channel's full video list. Please wait a moment.
